gaps.lead: The garage is servicing my car tomorrow morning.
gaps.explanation: Arranged service: have/get something done — having my car serviced.

gaps.lead: I only found out the truth because I asked.
gaps.sentence: I wouldn't have found out the truth ___ asked.
gaps.explanation: 'Because I asked' → 'if I hadn't asked' — a third conditional.

gaps.lead: It's very unlikely that Martin will win the 100 metres, as he's out of training.
gaps.sentence: Martin has almost ___ the 100 metres, as he's out of training.
gaps.explanation: 'It's very unlikely he will win' becomes 'he has almost no chance of winning'.

gaps.lead: Nadia's friend arrived just as she was about to leave the restaurant.
gaps.sentence: Nadia was ___ the restaurant when her friend arrived.
gaps.hint: be about to = be on the point of + -ing
gaps.explanation: 'About to leave' becomes 'on the point of leaving'.

gaps.lead: I always hated pasta when I was a child, but now I cook it regularly.
gaps.sentence: I ___ pasta when I was a child but now I cook it regularly.
gaps.explanation: 'used to + infinitive' describes a past state or habit that is no longer true.

gaps.lead: He began playing chess at the age of six.
gaps.sentence: He ___ at the age of six.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby or sport): took up chess.
